# MDL310 · `blank-lines`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

Several consecutive empty lines, or empty lines at the end of the file.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | case 32 |

## Why

Empty lines are harmless to GLib, but every empty line is a place where mydumper's pre-processor can produce a fatal `= 1` when the line above changes (see MDL108). One empty line between sections is enough.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4



[myloader]
threads=2

```

```text
4:1-6:1 info MDL310[blank-lines] 3 consecutive empty lines
  fix (safe): Keep a single empty line
8:1-9:1 info MDL310[blank-lines] 1 empty line at the end of the file
  fix (safe): Remove the empty lines at the end of the file
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4

[myloader]
threads=2
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL310: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL310` on the line above it.
